name: Conjuration Wizard Guild
license: GPL-3.0 (the game's own license; see LICENSE.txt)
description: A wizards' tower whose conjurers copy a card you carry: 2000 gold, then 4000, 8000 and 12000, and then never again.
learning_note: A self-contained place, and a study for the places players wish for: one sites plugin whose place stands on the mainland and on every island, with a service whose price climbs and then ends. Original fiction, not official Magic canon.
